item.title: Make My Photo Look Professional

turns.text: Make me look professional in this photo.

item.tests: Uses reasonable defaults for a vague professional portrait request without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: The portrait shows the same man, retaining his short grey hair and recognisable facial features.
His casual T-shirt is replaced with professional clothing such as a collared shirt or blazer.
The kitchen setting is replaced or simplified into an unobtrusive professional backdrop.
Harsh facial lighting is softened while retaining realistic skin texture.
The result is a clean head-and-shoulders portrait without visible editing artifacts.

turns.text: I'd like some help with how I come across in this pic. I've been feeling a little unsure about whether it gives the right impression. What I'm hoping you can do is make me, the man in the photo, look professional. I always find it surprisingly hard to judge my own photos.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t create the edit because Magic Hour reported insufficient credits. No edited image was produced.

Your direct eye contact and neat hair already work well for a professional portrait. The kitchen background, casual T-shirt, and uneven lighting are what make it feel more informal.

For a professional version, I’d keep your natural features and change just three things:
- A navy blazer over a light-blue, open-collar shirt.
- A simple neutral background.
- Softer, balanced lighting.

You could also get much of that effect without editing: stand facing a window against a plain wall, position the camera at eye level, and aim for a relaxed expression or slight smile.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Edit the supplied portrait of the man into a polished, photorealistic professional headshot. Preserve his exact identity, facial structure, age, short gray hair, natural stubble, eye color and realistic skin texture. Replace the casual gray T-shirt with a well-fitted navy business blazer over a crisp light blue open-collar shirt, no tie. Replace the kitchen entirely with a simple softly blurred neutral gray studio background. Use flattering soft balanced studio lighting, natural skin tones, clear eyes, and restrained professional retouching without smoothing away age or changing facial features. Keep his direct eye contact and a relaxed approachable expression, with only a very subtle natural smile. Frame head and shoulders in a centered square composition with comfortable headroom. The result should look like a genuine professional photograph of the same man, not a different person or a glamour makeover.
